item.title: Opinion: Lots of trash talking underway in Norfolk
item.description: A new era in waste collection is set to begin in late September in Norfolk County and, even though its goal is to reduce the strain on landfill sites, it seems several residents are balking at the plan.

item.title: NGH Volunteer Association donates $45,000
item.description: The Norfolk General Hospital Volunteer Association has donated $45,000 to purchase wheelchairs, bedside tables, and sleep chairs for patient rooms at Norfolk General Hospital (NGH).

item.title: Rotary Club of Norfolk Sunrise receives Peace and Reconciliation Grant
item.description: The Rotary Club of Norfolk Sunrise has received a $75,000 Rotary Global Grant that will bring together Indigenous and non-Indigenous youth leaders at an event next month in Ohsweken.
